summary: Repair attempt for upstream_contract_repair (phase-2-frontend-brand). The upstream rename src/features/reports/ -> src/features/report-center/ has already landed: the 8 report files live in src/features/report-center/, and src/App.tsx, src/features/result/ResultPage.tsx and src/features/settings/BrandSection.tsx import @/features/report-center/*. None of this unit's files import the old path, so no source change was needed. The unit's previous work stands: ConsultantHome 'O que precisa de você' (atrasada/vencidas/risco/rascunhos -> #/empresas?atencao=X, reevaluationDays), CompaniesPage ?atencao= filter with active-filter text, 'Nenhuma empresa encontrada' and 'Limpar filtros', ReevaluationSection (60/90 recomendado/120/180) wired into SettingsPage 'Lembrete de reavaliação'. pnpm typecheck (tsc --noEmit) now passes on the whole tree.

findings.summary: A plain `pnpm typecheck` exited 1 before tsc ran: pnpm's verify-deps-before-run saw package.json change (phase-7-backend-release is editing it at the same time) and started `pnpm install`. Its postinstall (`scripts/prepare-app.mjs`, `prisma migrate deploy`) then failed with 'SQLite database error: database is locked' on data/fitpulse.db. This was not a type error. The same script run with `pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=false typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) exited 0. After phase-7 finishes, integration should run `pnpm install` once with no process holding data/fitpulse.db.

Capability-level checks are outside this unit's Done when and were not run here: playwright tests/e2e/home.spec.ts, settings.spec.ts, companies.spec.ts, firstRun.spec.ts, accessibility.spec.ts (AC-ra-34 interval with reload, AC-ra-35 drill-down filters, AC-ra-62 mode switch), plus the Play dev-link walkthrough. They belong to integration, after the sibling e2e specs exist.
